subject: URGENT: data export fails every time, payroll due today
body:
Hi,

I need to export our timesheets for payroll, which is due at 5pm today. Every time I click Export > All time entries, the spinner runs for about a minute and then I get "Something went wrong (error E-EXP-504)". I've tried Chrome and Firefox, and a smaller date range (just October) fails the same way.

Is there another way to get the data out quickly? This is blocking pay for 60 staff.

Marcus Reid
Operations Manager, Holloway Foods
